title: The Lighthouse
shortLine: A keeper. A storm. A night that refuses to let him die.
synopsis: Behind a locked steel door, lighthouse keeper Jack endures a night that keeps returning to its beginning. The storm outside is only one kind of darkness; the other waits in the memories he has spent years trying to drown. As the night folds in on itself, guilt becomes a place with no exit.
imageAlt: A remote lighthouse facing a dark, turbulent sea
detailLine: Some doors open only onto the thing we have spent a lifetime fleeing.
underneath: A mind can turn punishment into a ritual and call it survival. The story asks whether a person can ever outrun a consequence that has become part of the self.
visualMotifs: A door struck from the other side
coreQuestion: When guilt becomes the only thing keeping you company, would freedom feel like salvation—or abandonment?

detailImage.alt: Dark water rolling beneath a dim sky
detailImage.caption: The sea repeats what the mind cannot release.
